text:
sara: drift-detector just flagged an env parity issue: prod eu-west-1 has per-az egress NATs enabled for gpu-nodepools, staging does not. Helm values and Terraform disagree. seeing SNAT errors in logs and a spike in egress retries.

mike: where did the detector pick it up? network policy diff or terraform drift?

sara: gitops-health scanned helm values in clusters and compared to values in git. It highlighted 'egress.natGateway.enabled' true in prod helm release 'cluster-network' but false in the gitops repo for eu-west-1 staging overlay.

raj: i ran a quick terraform plan against the infra account; terraform state shows nat gateways only in 2 AZs, but prod k8s has nodes across 3 AZs. plan snippet:
```
~ aws_route_table_association.nat[0]
    subnet_id: "subnet-0a1" => "subnet-0b2"
```
There's also an orphaned aws_nat_gateway resource in state for az-b that didn't get recreated after last deploy.

alice: that explains the SNAT failures for pods scheduled on az-b GPU nodes. Helm disabling nat in overlay was a config drift, probably an accidental revert in the staging overlay.

ci-bot: policycheck: OPA 'network-egress-az' FAILED for prod cluster: helm release cluster-network mismatch with policy (must have per-az natGateway enabled for gpu nodepool subnets).

mike: ok remediation options: 1) fix gitops helm values and roll out (preferred from infra policy perspective), 2) terraform create missing nat in az-b then reconcile git (fastest), 3) temporary cluster-level SNAT (hacky). thoughts?

raj: i'd avoid manual terraform apply without reconciling gitops. safe path: open gitops PR to re-enable natGateway for the overlay, trigger argo rollout with canary on cluster-network chart, monitor SNAT retries and cost. if pods still fail, import the missing nat into terraform and do a refresh-only apply:
```
terraform import aws_nat_gateway.missing nat-0abcd1234
terraform plan -refresh-only
```

alice: i'll open the gitops PR and add a note to the change that it's to restore parity for gpu pools. i'll also pin the helm chart so we don't get accidental overrides. PR will include the values patch:
```
egress:
  natGateway:
    enabled: true
    azs: [a, b, c]
```

sara: quick ask: cost team saw a 12% egress bump this week in eu-west; let's include cost-monitoring alert in the rollout so we can auto-rollback if cost > threshold.

mike: good call. set an alert on tokenized metric: infra.egress.cost.eu-west1 > 120% baseline => rollback. alice, can you add that to the argo rollout annotations?

alice: yep will add annotation and a prometheus query for the check. also adding a canary window of 10m.

raj: also filing a small tfstate hygiene ticket: run state prune for stale nat resources and verify association counts per-az. leaving notes on how to re-import if needed.

mike: PR opened by alice: https://git.redwood/ops/gitops/pulls/4824 - includes values and rollout annotations. i'm kicking the canary.

deploy-bot: Argo Rollout started for release cluster-network (namespace kube-system) -> canary 10m

sara: monitoring: SNAT retry rate down 40% on pods in az-b after partial rollout so far. cost alert still within bounds.

mike: if canary looks stable at +15m, we do full promote. raj, if it doesn't, proceed with terraform import plan so we have infra parity.

raj: noted. i'll be on standby and will run the import plan command if we see >70% failure rate or any stuck node taints.

alice: canary at 12m, metrics look good. promoting to stable now.

deploy-bot: Rollout promoted to stable. Helm release cluster-network updated.

sara: final check: drift-detector will run a diff against gitops tomorrow, but i reran now and both clusters report egress.natGateway.enabled = true. closing incident after 1hr stable window.

mike: thanks all. follow-up tasks: raj->tfstate hygiene ticket, alice->add helm chart pin + cost alert docs, sara->close drift incident and add root cause note in postmortems. :thumbsup:

alice: added checklist to PR and tagged finance + oncall.

sara: closing thread when the 1h window passes, current last_message_ts set to this thread end. thanks everyone.
